summary: Independent senior review (Fable-tier read, 2026-11-11) agrees MEDIUM and ordinary hardening: E1 does not apply (OIDC is opt-in; the route 404s unconfigured), on a glibc build the OIDC name lookups could wait about 30 s past the intended 10 s bound and now stop waiting at the bound, so the change is an improvement on origin/dev, and the callback is the only repeated entry point (start yields at most one discovery lookup per 30 s). Mitigations in this PR: a19687b807 puts OIDC start and callback in the login bucket (this closes pending-challenge eviction, SAML parity; it cuts one source from about 50 to 5 lookups per second but does not make the pool-full case impossible, so it is not recorded as the closure) and 6769e75cbf stops a pool-full refusal from arming the 30 s discovery window. Closure for the pool-full case = per-host lookup coalescing, a follow-up change.
